theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (U : Set (Rn N)) (μ₀ : Measure U) (ν₀ : U → Rn N), MeasurableSet U → (∀ K : Set U, IsCompact K → μ₀ K < ∞) → AEStronglyMeasurable ν₀ μ₀ → (∀ᵐ y ∂μ₀, ‖ν₀ y‖ = 1) → ∃ (μ : Measure (Rn N)) (ν : Rn N → Rn N), μ Uᶜ = 0 ∧ (∀ K : Set (Rn N), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ K < ∞) ∧ AEStronglyMeasurable ν μ ∧ (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ‖ν x‖ = 1) ∧ ∀ g : Rn N → Rn N, ∫ x, inner ℝ (g x) (ν x) ∂μ = ∫ y, inner ℝ (g ↑y) (ν₀ y) ∂μ₀
